phase3_findings.description: The authoritative failed-set establishment flag $failed_direct_present keys on container type only (($failed_raw | type) == "array"), not element validity. A present phase3_failed_agents array whose elements are malformed (e.g. [{"agent":"x"}] or ["real", 7]) is dropped by the `strings` filter into $failed_direct=[], yet $failed_direct_present stays true and is used as the blanket 'failed set established for every dispatched agent' signal ($failed_established) and re-exported as the durable phase3_failed_agents_present honesty flag. Result: a genuinely-failed or silent agent uncovered by the lossy parse reads disposition=silent (else arm) instead of unestablished. This is asymmetric with the shadow channel, which establishes coverage per-valid-entry via select(type==object and returned:boolean and agent:string), and it contradicts the docstring's own claim (jq lines ~84-89) that 'A malformed present value on either channel establishes nothing for the agents it fails to cover'. It re-collapses onto `silent` in exactly the unknown-is-not-zero case this change exists to prevent. Fix direction: derive $failed_direct_present (and the durable flag) from element-level well-formedness, mirroring the shadow channel's per-entry select, so a lossy parse does not read as full establishment. Note: debatable in that the direct sink's contract is that a well-formed array lists ALL non-returning agents; the fix loop should adjudicate whether an element-malformed array should establish nothing vs. still cover its valid entries.
phase3_findings.fix_decision_suggestion: Make direct-channel establishment element-aware (mirror the shadow per-entry select), and add a fixture for a present-array-with-malformed-elements shape asserting unestablished; alternatively push back with a disclosure that a well-formed-container array is contractually total and element-malformation is out of the honesty guarantee.

phase3_findings.description: The returned-wins-over-failed precedence in agent_disposition (if $returned then "returned" is checked before $is_failed) is untested: no fixture has an agent present in BOTH phase3_findings and the failed set. A regression reordering the arms would misclassify a returning agent as failed and stay green.
phase3_findings.fix_decision_suggestion: Add a fixture where an agent both returns findings and is named in phase3_failed_agents, asserting disposition=returned.

phase3_findings.description: The fix_decisions roll-up dedup (unique), sort, and strings type-guard are unexercised: only single-value (["deferred"]) and empty ([]) rolls are asserted. A regression dropping unique/strings/sort (e.g. two findings sharing a decision, or a non-string fix_decision) would not be caught.
phase3_findings.fix_decision_suggestion: Add a fixture with an agent carrying two findings (duplicate + distinct fix_decision, plus a non-string one) asserting the sorted-unique string set.

phase3_findings.description: The adversarial matrix over the shadow per_reviewer_assessment channel is partial: object/scalar/malformed-entry shapes are covered (iters 7-9), but the valid-falsy empty-array [] (the realistic 'shadow ran, captured no reviewers' case) and a non-object shadow block itself (scalar/array, guarded only by | objects) are not asserted.
phase3_findings.fix_decision_suggestion: Add fixtures for shadow.per_reviewer_assessment=[] and a non-object shadow block, asserting the agents read unestablished and the filter exits 0.

phase3_findings.description: The 'Denominator confound' paragraph in the jq header (lines ~68-72) is design/analysis narrative that restates in substance the paragraph added at docs/internal/efficiency-trace.md, while itself ending with '(see docs/internal/efficiency-trace.md)'. Per the comment-discipline rule, design narrative belongs in internal docs (the single home); trim the jq header to the pointer.
phase3_findings.fix_decision_suggestion: Reduce the jq header confound paragraph to the doc pointer alone.

phase3_findings.description: The 'null collapses opposite states' motivation is restated across the verdict_for header region (~58-61) and again opening the agent_disposition docstring (~111-115). The §2.3.4a restatement rule routes a fact stated in one added comment away from restatement in another; the docstring's load-bearing four-value spec should stay, the duplicated motivation preamble can be reduced to a cross-reference.
phase3_findings.fix_decision_suggestion: Drop or cross-reference the duplicated motivation preamble in the agent_disposition docstring.
